commit.message: a2a: harden semantic responder restart boundary

intent: Close every reproducible late-review defect from PR #1095 before the codex_composer semantic responder can be reloaded: make publication crash uncertainty terminal and non-replayable, replace pathname lease stealing with OS-backed ownership, preserve pinned artifacts under --no-publish, confine packet-derived paths, select only supported critic providers, root live outputs under DHARMA_STATE_DIR, make receipts collision-proof, and terminalize typed semantic failures. The authority boundary remains explicit: an unknown publication outcome or typed semantic failure is local terminal evidence only, never DomainPublished or EffectVerified.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from scripts.runtime.codex_composer_semantic_responder import PENDING_PUBLISH_STATUS, should_mark_processed; raise SystemExit(0 if not should_mark_processed(PENDING_PUBLISH_STATUS) else 1)"
negative_controls.name: publish-pending-remains-nonterminal

honest_blockers: The launchd semantic responder remains deliberately unloaded until this follow-up is merged, deployed from merged main, and one fresh benign packet proves SemanticSuccess without receipt or poison growth.
A PUBLISH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_DLQ receipt records uncertainty after a possible external effect. It intentionally forbids automatic replay and makes no claim that publication succeeded or failed.
The historical poison packet, immutable dead letter, processed-ledger row, pinned artifact evidence, and 9817 pending receipts remain untouched.
interface_mismatches: The publisher has an external side effect but the responder previously persisted terminal delivery state only after publication returned, allowing crash replay.
The responder lease used unlinkable TTL pathnames instead of process-lifetime ownership, allowing an ABA race between stale and new owners.
The semantic drain default provider order excluded Ollama even though the critic runner currently supports only Ollama.
Packet identifiers crossed into artifact paths without a strict lexical and resolved-path confinement contract.
session_entry.rollback: Keep the responder unloaded, revert the packet-scoped follow-up commit, and preserve every immutable runtime receipt, pending artifact, in-flight marker, dead letter, and processed-ledger row for audit. Never restart the pre-hardening responder.
